capabilities: Sync Markdown flashcards to Anki notes
Update existing notes by stored Anki note ID
Build image occlusion cards with a mask editor
Import local images, audio and video into Anki media
Filter synced notes by path patterns
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync: Obsidian is the content source, and edits made in Anki are overwritten on the next sync.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.5.7+); Anki must stay running during sync; the manifest description is only a GitHub URL; no telemetry, and data goes only to the configured AnkiConnect address.
intentEvidence: This project is forked from joeyyu123/obsidian-anki-cloze-sync and has been further developed
problem: Cards written inside Obsidian notes have to be retyped in Anki, and repeated syncing easily creates duplicate notes or writes one card's content into another's note.

relations.evidence: This project is forked from joeyyu123/obsidian-anki-cloze-sync
Anki Desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on installed.

summary: Syncs Markdown flashcards — Q&A, cloze, choice, code practice and image occlusion — into Anki notes through AnkiConnect, keyed by Anki note ID.
